---
title: Callout kind and appearance
format: typst
keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - - 'kind:\s+"warning"\s*,\s*appearance:\s+"default"'
          - 'kind:\s+"tip"\s*,\s*appearance:\s+"minimal"'
          - 'kind:\s+"important"\s*,\s*appearance:\s+"simple"'
          - 'kind:\s+"note"\s*,\s*appearance:\s+"minimal"'
          - 'kind:\s+"none"\s*,\s*appearance:\s+"simple"'
        - []
      ensurePdfRegexMatches:
        - ['Note 1']
        - []
      noErrors: default
---

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal"}
Body.
:::

::: {.callout-important appearance="simple"}
Body.
:::

::: {#nte-x .callout-note appearance="minimal"}
